narrative: Nvidia's N1/N1X are explicitly positioned as dedicated on-device inference silicon - co-designed with Microsoft to run a local agent - while Nvidia simultaneously holds the data-center training layer and the licensed Groq inference IP. That reinforces the divergent-compute-profile premise driving a training-versus-inference bifurcation, but Nvidia is a merchant vendor pushing into client inference, not a hyperscaler splitting its own part numbers.
remaining_gap: The landing names hyperscaler in-house silicon (MAIA, MTIA, TPU, Trainium) bifurcating into separate training and inference SKUs; a merchant edge-inference chip is adjacent, not that split.
